requirements.verifier_assertion: All nine deliverables exist and are non-empty: outputs/{customers_cleaned.csv, transactions_cleaned.csv, products_cleaned.csv, rejected_records.csv, aggregated_metrics.csv, dimensions_audit.txt, quality_report.html, manifest.md5} and scripts/run_pipeline.sh.
Field-standardization rules, rejection-reason vocabulary, and exact column conventions per output file are enforced exactly as specified in the two referenced spec files.
Latin-1 source is decoded so accented names (José, Núñez) are preserved correctly as UTF-8 rather than left as mojibake.
Every row rejected by the rules or failing conversion is fully archived into rejected_records.csv with a reason; row accounting balances (clean + rejected = raw total, at least one rejected).
The three cleaned tables are joined and transaction statistics aggregated by product category and customer region into aggregated_metrics.csv.
An offline HTML quality report is produced with the missing-value distribution, grouped aggregation stats, and a quality-score table, referencing no external/remote resources.
An md5 manifest of all input and output files is generated for future verification and its checksums validate.
The whole pipeline is wrapped into a re-runnable script at scripts/run_pipeline.sh.
